Who usually gives the paediatric history?
The mother or carer (the child when old enough).
Parts unique to the paediatric history?
Perinatal, feeding, developmental and vaccination history.
How is the chief complaint written?
In the mother's words, with duration.
Points to analyse in each complaint?
Onset, course, character, aggravating/relieving, associated symptoms, treatment.
What else is asked in HPI?
Relevant negatives and impact on feeding, sleep, activity.
